
. open_section_log IMPORT_AND_HARMONIZATION


============================================================
SECTION: IMPORT_AND_HARMONIZATION
============================================================

. 
. use "$infile", clear

. 
. * Harmonize participant ID.
. capture confirm variable HNDid

. if _rc {
.     capture confirm variable HNDID
.     if !_rc rename HNDID HNDid
. }

. assert_var_exists HNDid

. assert_var_exists HNDwave

. 
. * Ensure wave variable is numeric before filtering.
. capture confirm numeric variable HNDwave

. if _rc {
.     destring HNDwave, replace ignore(" .NAnaNAN/A")
. }

. 
. * Keep requested HANDLS waves.
. keep if inlist(HNDwave, 1, 3, 4)
(0 observations deleted)

. 
. * Harmonize likely alternate variable names to manuscript/code names.
. foreach pair in ///
>     "Age age" ///
>     "BMI bmi" ///
>     "WaistSize waist" ///
>     "WaistSize waist_circumference" ///
>     "WaistSize wc" ///
>     "dxDiabetes diabetes" ///
>     "dxDiabetes diab" ///
>     "Sex sex" ///
>     "Race race" ///
>     "EducationYr educationyr" ///
>     "EducationYr educyrs" ///
>     "PovStat povstat" ///
>     "CigaretteStatus smoking" ///
>     "CigaretteStatus smoke" ///
>     "AlcStatus alcohol" ///
>     "hei2010_total_score hei2010" ///
>     "hei2010_total_score HEI2010" ///
>  {
  2.     gettoken target source : pair
  3.     capture confirm variable `target'
  4.     if _rc {
  5.         capture confirm variable `source'
  6.         if !_rc rename `source' `target'
  7.     }
  8. }

. 
. * Keep core variables used in manuscript-aligned HANDLS validation analysis.
. keep HNDid HNDwave Age BMI WaistSize dxDiabetes Sex Race EducationYr PovStat ///
>      CigaretteStatus AlcStatus hei2010_total_score 

.

============================================================
SECTION: CLEAN_LONG_VARIABLES
============================================================

.

  2.     capture confirm numeric variable `v'
  3.     if _rc {
  4.         capture destring `v', replace ignore(" .NAnaNAN/A")
  5.     }
  6. }

. 
. foreach v in Age BMI WaistSize EducationYr hei2010_total_score  {
  2.     capture confirm numeric variable `v'
  3.     if !_rc replace `v' = . if `v' < 0
  4. }
(0 real changes made)
(0 real changes made)
(0 real changes made)
(0 real changes made)
(0 real changes made)

(0 real changes made)

(0 real changes made)

(0 real changes made)

> 0
(0 real changes made)

.

. * binary diabetes indicators after reshaping. Prevalent diabetes exclusion
. * at baseline is based on dxDiabetes==3.
. replace dxDiabetes = . if !inlist(dxDiabetes,1,2,3,.)
(0 real changes made)

. 
. * Remove duplicate person-wave rows.
. duplicates report HNDid HNDwave

Duplicates in terms of HNDid HNDwave

        1 |         8359             0

. ** 4. RESHAPE LONG TO WIDE PERSON-LEVEL FILE
. ********************************************************************************

. open_section_log RESHAPE_WIDE


============================================================
SECTION: RESHAPE_WIDE
============================================================

. 
. reshape wide Age BMI WaistSize dxDiabetes Sex Race EducationYr PovStat ///
>              CigaretteStatus AlcStatus hei2010_total_score , i(HNDid) j(HNDwave)
(j = 1 3 4)

Data                               Long   ->   Wide
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Number of observations            8,359   ->   3,720       
Number of variables                  13   ->   34          
j variable (3 values)           HNDwave   ->   (dropped)
xij variables:
                                    Age   ->   Age1 Age3 Age4
                                    BMI   ->   BMI1 BMI3 BMI4
                              WaistSize   ->   WaistSize1 WaistSize3 WaistSize4
                             dxDiabetes   ->   dxDiabetes1 dxDiabetes3 dxDiabetes4
                                    Sex   ->   Sex1 Sex3 Sex4
                                   Race   ->   Race1 Race3 Race4
                            EducationYr   ->   EducationYr1 EducationYr3 EducationYr4
                                PovStat   ->   PovStat1 PovStat3 PovStat4
                        CigaretteStatus   ->   CigaretteStatus1 CigaretteStatus3 Cigare
> tteStatus4
                              AlcStatus   ->   AlcStatus1 AlcStatus3 AlcStatus4
                    hei2010_total_score   ->   hei2010_total_score1 hei2010_total_score
> 3 hei2010_total_score4
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

. program define incidence_table_putexcel
  1.     syntax, GROUPVAR(name) SHEET(string) [STARTROW(integer 4)]
  2. 
.     putexcel set "$xlsx", sheet("`sheet'") modify
  3.     putexcel A1 = "Incident diabetes cases, person-years, and rates per 10,000 per
> son-years"
  4.     putexcel A2 = "Rates are descriptive and use observed m=0 MI-eligible data."
  5.     putexcel A3 = "Exposure" B3 = "Category" C3 = "Cases" D3 = "N" E3 = "Person-ye
> ars" F3 = "Rate per 10,000 PY" G3 = "Lower 95% CI" H3 = "Upper 95% CI"
  6.     local row = `startrow'
  7.     levelsof `groupvar' if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1, local(levels)
  8.     foreach lev of local levels {
  9.         count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & `groupvar'==`lev'
 10.         local n = r(N)
 11.         count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & `groupvar'==`lev' & fail_diabetes==1
 12.         local cases = r(N)
 13.         summarize fu_yrs if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & `groupvar'==`lev', meanonl
> y
 14.         local py = r(sum)
 15.         local rate = .
 16.         local ll = .
 17.         local ul = .
 18.         if `py' > 0 {
 19.             local rate = 10000*`cases'/`py'
 20.             if `cases' == 0 {
 21.                 local ll = 0
 22.                 local ul = 10000*0.5*invchi2(2*(`cases'+1), .975)/`py'
 23.             }
 24.             else {
 25.                 local ll = 10000*0.5*invchi2(2*`cases', .025)/`py'
 26.                 local ul = 10000*0.5*invchi2(2*(`cases'+1), .975)/`py'
 27.             }
 28.         }
 29.         local vl : value label `groupvar'
 30.         if "`vl'" == "" local cat "`lev'"
 31.         else local cat : label `vl' `lev'
 32.         putexcel A`row' = "`groupvar'" B`row' = "`cat'" C`row' = `cases' D`row' = 
> `n' E`row' = `py' F`row' = `rate' G`row' = `ll' H`row' = `ul'
 33.         local ++row
 34.     }
 35. end

. capture program drop make_mi_cox_table

. program define make_mi_cox_table
  1.     syntax, EXPOSURE(name) SHEET(string)
  2. 
.     tempfile results
  3.     postfile handle str24 table str30 model str40 exposure str100 category ///
>         double HR LCL UCL P N_EVENTS N_SUBJECTS using `results', replace
  4. 
.     * Unadjusted MI Cox model
.     capture noisily mi estimate, hr dots post: stcox ib1.`exposure'
  5.     if _rc == 0 {
  6.         count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & fail_diabetes==1
  7.         local nevents = r(N)
  8. 
.         count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1
  9.         local nsubjects = r(N)
 10. 
.         estimates store unadj_`exposure'
 11. 
.         levelsof `exposure' if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1, local(levels)
 12. 
.         foreach lev of local levels {
 13.             if `lev' != 1 {
 14.                 capture noisily lincom `lev'.`exposure', hr
 15.                 if _rc == 0 {
 16.                     local vl : value label `exposure'
 17.                     if "`vl'" == "" local cat "`lev'"
 18.                     else local cat : label `vl' `lev'
 19. 
.                     post handle ("`sheet'") ("unadjusted_mi") ("`exposure'") ("`cat'"
> ) ///
>                         (r(estimate)) (r(lb)) (r(ub)) (r(p)) (`nevents') (`nsubjects'
> )
 20.                 }
 21.             }
 22.         }
 23.     }
 24. 
.     * Fully adjusted MI Cox model
.     capture noisily mi estimate, hr dots post: stcox ib1.`exposure' $COV_FULL
 25.     if _rc == 0 {
 26.         count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & fail_diabetes==1
 27.         local nevents = r(N)
 28. 
.         count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1
 29.         local nsubjects = r(N)
 30. 
.         estimates store full_`exposure'
 31. 
.         levelsof `exposure' if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1, local(levels)
 32. 
.         foreach lev of local levels {
 33.             if `lev' != 1 {
 34.                 capture noisily lincom `lev'.`exposure', hr
 35.                 if _rc == 0 {
 36.                     local vl : value label `exposure'
 37.                     if "`vl'" == "" local cat "`lev'"
 38.                     else local cat : label `vl' `lev'
 39. 
.                     post handle ("`sheet'") ("full_mi") ("`exposure'") ("`cat'") ///
>                         (r(estimate)) (r(lb)) (r(ub)) (r(p)) (`nevents') (`nsubjects'
> )
 40.                 }
 41.             }
 42.         }
 43.     }
 44. 
.     postclose handle
 45. 
.     preserve
 46.         use `results', clear
 47.         export excel using "$xlsx", sheet("`sheet'", replace) firstrow(variables)
 48.     restore
 49. end

. capture program drop mi_concordance_summary

. program define mi_concordance_summary
  1.     syntax , MODELTAG(string) EXPOSURE(name) SHEET(string) NIMP(integer) [COVARS(s
> tring)]
  2. 
.     tempfile mi_master
  3.     save `mi_master', replace
  4. 
.     putexcel set "$xlsx", sheet("`sheet'_ByImp") modify
  5.     putexcel A1=("Model")
  6.     putexcel B1=("Exposure")
  7.     putexcel C1=("Imputation")
  8.     putexcel D1=("Harrell_C")
  9.     putexcel E1=("N_EVENTS")
 10.     putexcel F1=("N_SUBJECTS")
 11.     putexcel G1=("Status")
 12. 
.     local row = 2
 13.     local sum_c = 0
 14.     local sum_c2 = 0
 15.     local min_c = .
 16.     local max_c = .
 17.     local n_imp_c = 0
 18.     local sum_events = 0
 19.     local n_events_ok = 0
 20.     local sum_subjects = 0
 21.     local n_subjects_ok = 0
 22. 
.     forvalues mm = 1/`nimp' {
 23. 
.         use `mi_master', clear
 24.         mi extract `mm', clear
 25. 
.         local cval = .
 26.         local nevents = .
 27.         local nsubjects = .
 28.         local status "Not run"
 29. 
.         capture noisily stset fu_yrs if mi_eligible==1, ///
>             failure(fail_diabetes==1) id(HNDid)
 30. 
.         if _rc==0 {
 31.             capture noisily stcox ib1.`exposure' `covars'
 32. 
.             if _rc==0 {
 33.                 count if e(sample) & fail_diabetes==1
 34.                 local nevents = r(N)
 35. 
.                 count if e(sample)
 36.                 local nsubjects = r(N)
 37. 
.                 capture noisily estat concordance
 38. 
.                 if _rc==0 {
 39.                     capture confirm scalar r(C)
 40.                     if !_rc local cval = r(C)
 41. 
.                     if missing(`cval') {
 42.                         capture confirm scalar r(c)
 43.                         if !_rc local cval = r(c)
 44.                     }
 45. 
.                     if missing(`cval') {
 46.                         capture confirm scalar r(concordance)
 47.                         if !_rc local cval = r(concordance)
 48.                     }
 49. 
.                     local status "OK"
 50.                 }
 51.                 else {
 52.                     local status "estat concordance failed"
 53.                 }
 54.             }
 55.             else {
 56.                 local status "stcox failed"
 57.             }
 58.         }
 59.         else {
 60.             local status "stset failed"
 61.         }
 62. 
.         putexcel A`row'=("`modeltag'")
 63.         putexcel B`row'=("`exposure'")
 64.         putexcel C`row'=(`mm')
 65.         putexcel D`row'=(`cval')
 66.         putexcel E`row'=(`nevents')
 67.         putexcel F`row'=(`nsubjects')
 68.         putexcel G`row'=("`status'")
 69. 
.         if !missing(`cval') {
 70.             local sum_c = `sum_c' + `cval'
 71.             local sum_c2 = `sum_c2' + (`cval' * `cval')
 72.             local n_imp_c = `n_imp_c' + 1
 73. 
.             if missing(`min_c') local min_c = `cval'
 74.             if missing(`max_c') local max_c = `cval'
 75.             if `cval' < `min_c' local min_c = `cval'
 76.             if `cval' > `max_c' local max_c = `cval'
 77.         }
 78. 
.         if !missing(`nevents') {
 79.             local sum_events = `sum_events' + `nevents'
 80.             local n_events_ok = `n_events_ok' + 1
 81.         }
 82. 
.         if !missing(`nsubjects') {
 83.             local sum_subjects = `sum_subjects' + `nsubjects'
 84.             local n_subjects_ok = `n_subjects_ok' + 1
 85.         }
 86. 
.         local row = `row' + 1
 87.     }
 88. 
.     local mean_c = .
 89.     local sd_c = .
 90.     local mean_events = .
 91.     local mean_subjects = .
 92. 
.     if `n_imp_c' > 0 {
 93.         local mean_c = `sum_c' / `n_imp_c'
 94.     }
 95. 
.     if `n_imp_c' > 1 {
 96.         local var_c = (`sum_c2' - (`sum_c' * `sum_c' / `n_imp_c')) / (`n_imp_c' - 
> 1)
 97.         if `var_c' < 0 local var_c = 0
 98.         local sd_c = sqrt(`var_c')
 99.     }
100. 
.     if `n_events_ok' > 0 {
101.         local mean_events = `sum_events' / `n_events_ok'
102.     }
103. 
.     if `n_subjects_ok' > 0 {
104.         local mean_subjects = `sum_subjects' / `n_subjects_ok'
105.     }
106. 
.     putexcel set "$xlsx", sheet("`sheet'_Summary") modify
107.     putexcel A1=("Model")
108.     putexcel B1=("Exposure")
109.     putexcel C1=("Imputations with concordance")
110.     putexcel D1=("Mean Harrell C")
111.     putexcel E1=("SD Harrell C")
112.     putexcel F1=("Minimum Harrell C")
113.     putexcel G1=("Maximum Harrell C")
114.     putexcel H1=("Mean events")
115.     putexcel I1=("Mean subjects")
116.     putexcel J1=("Note")
117. 
.     putexcel A2=("`modeltag'")
118.     putexcel B2=("`exposure'")
119.     putexcel C2=(`n_imp_c')
120.     putexcel D2=(`mean_c')
121.     putexcel E2=(`sd_c')
122.     putexcel F2=(`min_c')
123.     putexcel G2=(`max_c')
124.     putexcel H2=(`mean_events')
125.     putexcel I2=(`mean_subjects')
126.     putexcel J2=("Concordance summarized across imputed datasets; not Rubin-pooled
> .")
127. 
.     use `mi_master', clear
128. end

.

. capture program drop post_mi_stratified_cox

. program define post_mi_stratified_cox
  1.     syntax, EXPOSURE(name) SHEET(string)
  2. 
.     tempfile results
  3.     postfile handle str24 table str30 stratum str80 subgroup str100 category ///
>         double HR LCL UCL P N_EVENTS N_SUBJECTS using `results', replace
  4. 
.     capture noisily mi estimate, hr dots post: stcox ib1.`exposure' $COV_FULL
  5.     if _rc==0 {
  6.         count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & fail_diabetes==1
  7.         local nevents=r(N)
  8.         count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1
  9.         local nsubjects=r(N)
 10.         levelsof `exposure' if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1, local(levels)
 11.         foreach lev of local levels {
 12.             if `lev' != 1 {
 13.                 capture noisily lincom `lev'.`exposure', hr
 14.                 if _rc==0 {
 15.                     local vl : value label `exposure'
 16.                     if "`vl'" == "" local cat "`lev'"
 17.                     else local cat : label `vl' `lev'
 18.                     post handle ("`sheet'") ("Overall_MI") ("All women") ("`cat'")
>  ///
>                         (r(estimate)) (r(lb)) (r(ub)) (r(p)) (`nevents') (`nsubjects'
> )
 19.                 }
 20.             }
 21.         }
 22.     }
 23. 
.     levelsof agecat_bl if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1, local(agelevels)
 24.     foreach s of local agelevels {
 25.         local sl : label agecatlbl `s'
 26.         capture noisily mi estimate, hr dots post: stcox ib1.`exposure' $COV_AGE_S
> TRAT if agecat_bl==`s'
 27.         if _rc==0 {
 28.             count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & agecat_bl==`s' & fail_diabetes==1
 29.             local nevents=r(N)
 30.             count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & agecat_bl==`s'
 31.             local nsubjects=r(N)
 32.             levelsof `exposure' if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & agecat_bl==`s', loc
> al(levels)
 33.             foreach lev of local levels {
 34.                 if `lev' != 1 {
 35.                     capture noisily lincom `lev'.`exposure', hr
 36.                     if _rc==0 {
 37.                         local vl : value label `exposure'
 38.                         if "`vl'" == "" local cat "`lev'"
 39.                         else local cat : label `vl' `lev'
 40.                         post handle ("`sheet'") ("Age_MI") ("`sl'") ("`cat'") ///
>                             (r(estimate)) (r(lb)) (r(ub)) (r(p)) (`nevents') (`nsubje
> cts')
 41.                     }
 42.                 }
 43.             }
 44.         }
 45.     }
 46. 
.     levelsof race_cat if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1, local(racelevels)
 47.     foreach r of local racelevels {
 48.         local vlrace : value label race_cat
 49.         if "`vlrace'" == "" local rl "race_cat=`r'"
 50.         else local rl : label `vlrace' `r'
 51.         capture noisily mi estimate, hr dots post: stcox ib1.`exposure' $COV_RACE_
> STRAT if race_cat==`r'
 52.         if _rc==0 {
 53.             count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & race_cat==`r' & fail_diabetes==1
 54.             local nevents=r(N)
 55.             count if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & race_cat==`r'
 56.             local nsubjects=r(N)
 57.             levelsof `exposure' if _mi_m==0 & mi_eligible==1 & race_cat==`r', loca
> l(levels)
 58.             foreach lev of local levels {
 59.                 if `lev' != 1 {
 60.                     capture noisily lincom `lev'.`exposure', hr
 61.                     if _rc==0 {
 62.                         local vl : value label `exposure'
 63.                         if "`vl'" == "" local cat "`lev'"
 64.                         else local cat : label `vl' `lev'
 65.                         post handle ("`sheet'") ("Race_MI") ("`rl'") ("`cat'") ///
>                             (r(estimate)) (r(lb)) (r(ub)) (r(p)) (`nevents') (`nsubje
> cts')
 66.                     }
 67.                 }
 68.             }
 69.         }
 70.     }
 71. 
.     postclose handle
 72.     preserve
 73.         use `results', clear
 74.         export excel using "$xlsx", sheet("`sheet'", replace) firstrow(variables)
 75.     restore
 76. end
